title: PreTENS - Presuppositional Acceptability
description: Judge the acceptability of sentences whose two nominal arguments are presupposed to stand (or not) in an ordered taxonomic relation. Includes a binary acceptable/unacceptable judgment and a 1-7 acceptability rating. Based on SemEval-2022 Task 3 (Zamparelli et al.).
